name: find_location
description: Resolve what the caller said into real Swiss Post locations, live from Swiss Post's public location service. Accepts a municipality, a four-digit postcode, a branch name, or a whole spoken sentence such as 'die Post in Burgdorf' — filler words are stripped automatically. Call this first, before any other location tool; every other tool needs a location_id from here. Results are ordered with staffed branches first, then partner counters, then parcel terminals, so the first result is usually the one the caller means. RETURNS { found, ambiguous, matched_via, locations, places, ask_for_postcode, error }. Each location has id, name, type_label, address, service_labels, open_now, open_until, distance_km, walking_minutes, status, status_label, closure_date, days_until_closure. If ambiguous is true, read the options back and let the caller choose. If ask_for_postcode is true nothing matched — ask for the four-digit postcode. If error is present the location service could not be reached: say you cannot look it up right now and never invent an answer.

request_body_schema.description: Location lookup: what the caller said, plus the language they said it in.

properties.description: What the caller said about the location — municipality, postcode, branch name, or the whole phrase. Pass it through as spoken; do not clean it up.
The language the caller is speaking, as a two-letter code: 'de', 'fr', 'it' or 'en'. Location names, service labels, status labels and holiday names come back in it.
